# AgentBiz quant-research support

This is a public alpha. Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/daichunghy/quant-research/discussions) for first-run questions and [issues](https://github.com/daichunghy/quant-research/issues) for reproducible contract or emitter defects.

The supported quickstart is the tagged GitHub clone followed by `npm ci` and `npm run verify`. The package emits research contracts and specifications; it does not run SEM, compute fit indices, write spreadsheets, or establish ethical approval.

Do not include respondent-level data, student records, credentials, or payment information. Security reports belong in [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/daichunghy/quant-research/security/advisories/new).
